name: Dusk
description: Blue hour after sunset: rose/violet afterglow on one horizon, deep blue-violet zenith; for headlight driving.

conventions.space: three.js world space, Y up, equirect used with EquirectangularReflectionMapping and no rotation
conventions.azimuth: degrees, atan2(x, z): 0 = +Z, 90 = +X, 180 = -Z, 270 = -X; direction = (cos(el) sin(az), sin(el), cos(el) cos(az))
conventions.horizonColors: 8 sectors of 45 deg centred on azimuth 0, 45, ... 315; elevation band 1..6 deg
conventions.fogColor: per-channel median of horizonColors (use horizonColors / sunsideHazeColor for direction-dependent fog)
conventions.colors: linear sRGB (Rec.709 primaries), radiance in the units of sky.hdr / env.hdr
conventions.sunIntensity: DirectionalLight.intensity for color = sunColor; intensity * color = irradiance removed from env.hdr
conventions.backgroundClamp: suggested min( skyRadiance, backgroundClamp ) for the visible sky before bloom / TAA (null = not needed)

author: Greg Zaal (photography), Jarod Guest (processing)
